SELECT
  LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CODE)) AS Code,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(c.DEFINITION_)) AS Title,
  CASE c.CARDTYPE WHEN 1 THEN N'Alıcı' WHEN 2 THEN N'Satıcı' ELSE N'Alıcı / Satıcı' END AS Type_,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.TAXNR)), N''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.VATNR)), N''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.TCKNO)), N'')) AS TaxNr,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(c.TAXOFFICE)) AS TaxOffice,
  CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.ISPERSCOMP, 0) = 1 THEN N'Gerçek' ELSE N'Tüzel' END AS TaxType,
  CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.ACCEPTEINV, 0) = 1 THEN N'e-Fatura' WHEN ISNULL(c.EINVOICETYPE, 0) = 2 THEN N'e-Arşiv' ELSE N'Yok' END AS EinvoiceType,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(c.TELNRS1)) AS U_Phone,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(c.EMAILADDR)) AS U_Email,
  NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.COUNTRY)), N'') AS Addr_Country,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CITY)) AS Addr_City,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(c.TOWN)) AS Addr_Town,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(c.DISTRICT)) AS Addr_District,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(c.ADDR1, N'') + N' ' + ISNULL(c.ADDR2, N''))) AS Addr_Address,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(c.POSTLABELCODE)) AS Addr_PostLabel,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(c.SENDERLABELCODE)) AS Addr_SenderLabel,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(c.INCHARGE)) AS Contact_Name,
  CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.ACTIVE, 0) = 0 THEN N'Evet' ELSE N'Hayır' END AS Active
FROM dbo.LG_421_CLCARD c WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE c.CARDTYPE IN (1, 2, 3)
  AND c.CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CODE)) <> N''
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CODE)) NOT LIKE N'ÿ%'
ORDER BY c.CODE
